name: voltpilot-edge-deye-decode
description: Canonical, unit-tested reference for the Deye Node-RED template: the Solarman-V5 transport codec (solarman-v5.js, TCP 8899, recommended), the AT-CLI +ok=0103 parser, the per-family register maps + telemetry decode (deye-decode.js), and the standalone hardware probe (solarman-probe.js). The flows.json function nodes carry a synced copy of this logic.
